metadata.methods_description: Data were collected in a hemi-anechoic chamber. Experiment 1 (Deviant Detection) involved subjects hearing adapter noise from one loudspeaker followed by probe bursts from different elevations, with behavioral responses recorded via button press. Experiment 2 (One-Back) presented white noise through headphones followed by loudspeaker bursts at various elevations, with target trials requiring sound localization responses. A subset of subjects in Experiment 2 completed a second session with ear canal molds to disrupt elevation perception.
